title: Expense splitter frontend (UI for adding expenses, listing expenses, and viewing settlements)
declaredInterface: React SPA on Vite dev server (proxying /api to backend :3001 or calling :3001 directly with CORS)
assumptions: Frontend built with React + Vite + Tailwind/modern CSS (or lightweight modern stack) communicating with the Express backend on port 3001. Features: Add Expense form with dynamic participants, Expenses list with delete action, Balances summary showing net balances and simplified debt settlement list, and quick suggestions for participants.

completion.whatWasBuilt: Built a full-featured React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS frontend dashboard (SplitEase) for the group expense splitter, complete with an expense creation form, live split breakdown, searchable transaction timeline, net balance meters, simplified settle-up transfer flows, and backend CORS integration.

decisions.decision: Vite + React 18 + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
decisions.why: Provides fast development iterations, clean responsive styling, and modern UI iconography out of the box.

decisions.decision: Added CORS headers to backend Express app in addition to Vite proxy
decisions.why: Ensures smooth cross-origin API communication whether running via dev server proxy or calling direct localhost:3001.
decisions.alternativesConsidered: Only Vite proxy without backend CORS

decisions.decision: Inline participant chip toggling and addition in the expense form
decisions.why: Allows seamless creation of new group members without interrupting the expense creation workflow.
decisions.alternativesConsidered: Separate page for managing group members

filesChanged.purpose: Enabled CORS headers and preflight handling for web client access
React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons manifest
Vite configuration with API proxy and React plugin
REST API client for backend communication
Top navigation with health indicator and quick refresh
Expense entry form with category tags and live per-person breakdown
Searchable, filterable expense history with deletion support

Main dashboard orchestrator and toast notifications
Root workspace script runners for backend and frontend

completion.knownLimitations: Backend uses in-memory storage (data resets on restart); equal split only for v1; single currency.
completion.nextSteps: Optional persistent database integration (e.g. SQLite), unequal / custom percentage splits, and multi-currency support.
